stem: After transplanting into smaller containers with lower water-holding capacity, the previous irrigation event size produces drainage much earlier. Which adjustment is best supported?
choices: Keep the previous event size because the crop stage has not changed enough to justify altering irrigation volume
Increase fertilizer concentration so the smaller containers retain water longer between irrigation events
Re-evaluate event size and frequency against the new container/media water-holding behavior and crop demand
Reduce moisture monitoring during the transition so the new containers can establish a stable drainage pattern
rationale: Container and media changes can alter water storage and drainage. Irrigation event size and frequency should be reassessed against measured root-zone behavior rather than copied unchanged from the previous setup.
